title: Airlines criticise air traffic control as second glitch causes more disruption
description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said further issues today "cause even greater concern" about the UK's air traffic control and the head of the organisation that runs it.

title: UK to provide Saudi Arabia with 'defensive' military support, says Burnham
description: The prime minister says "defensive air-to-air refuelling" is to be provided following a request from Saudi Arabia, after it faced attacks from the Houthis in Yemen.

title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
description: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
description: Dr Vincent Brown, formerly Dr Vincent Bajinya, 65, will appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Tuesday charged with seven offences.

title: Flights at major US airports delayed after cable cut by construction workers
description: Verizon, which owns the cable, says it is working to repair it "as quickly as possible".

title: Watch: Police raid organised crime targets in Teesside
description: Cleveland Police carried out one of their biggest raids in years, following the A66 crash that left two officers dead.

title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico file lawsuit against Trump's White House ban
description: Major US networks later suspended White House TV coverage of Trump as he heads to New York for the UN summit.

title: Infantino says he is open to Fifa reform
description: Fifa president Gianni Infantino has proposed an external review of how world football's governing body operates. shifting tone as he seeks support to stay on.

title: Death of Cindy Crawford's son Presley Gerber being investigated as suspected overdose
description: His family asked for privacy during a "very difficult and painful time" following the model's death.
